title: Soy-Pear Dak Bulgogi
shortDescription: Boneless chicken thigh is marinated with soy sauce, pear, onion, garlic, and sesame, then grilled to a verified poultry temperature.
culturalContext: Dak bulgogi refers to seasoned grilled chicken and overlaps in naming with several Korean chicken traditions. Marinade, cut, heat source, and accompaniments vary; this draft uses a soy-pear profile.
author: {{LEGAL_NAME}}
equipment: Outdoor grill or manufacturer-approved indoor electric grill

ingredients.preparation: trimmed and opened to even thickness; do not wash

marinadeOrSeasoning.meatWeightCovered: 900 g / 2 pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs
mixOrder: Combine soy sauce, pear, onion, and rice syrup.
Stir in garlic, ginger, sesame oil, and pepper.
marinadeOrSeasoning.marinationVessel: Nonreactive covered container at or below 40°F / 4°C
marinadeOrSeasoning.maximumPracticalMarinationWarning: Do not exceed 8 hours without test-cook approval.
marinadeOrSeasoning.reserveBeforeRawContactInstruction: Reserve any serving sauce before the marinade contacts raw meat.
marinadeOrSeasoning.rawContactDiscardOrReboilInstruction: Discard marinade that contacted raw meat; do not brush it onto cooked food.
substitutions: Use certified gluten-free tamari only after verifying every label.

instructions.heading: Prepare safely
instructions.action: Open chicken thighs to even thickness on a dedicated board; do not wash raw chicken; refrigerate promptly and wash hands.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Thighs are even in thickness and remain cold.
instructions.safetyNote: Do not wash raw chicken because splashing can spread contamination.

instructions.heading: Mix the marinade
instructions.action: Stir all marinade ingredients until evenly combined.
instructions.safetyNote: Reserve any serving sauce before raw-meat contact.

instructions.heading: Marinate under refrigeration
instructions.action: Coat chicken, cover, and refrigerate for 1 hour.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Every piece has a thin, even coating.
instructions.safetyNote: Never marinate meat at room temperature.

instructions.heading: Preheat the grill
instructions.action: Preheat a clean outdoor grill or manufacturer-approved indoor electric grill; establish the heat zones described below.
instructions.temperature: Medium heat with an open cooler zone
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: The grate is hot, clean, and lightly oiled.
instructions.safetyNote: Never use a fuel-burning grill indoors; follow electric-grill ventilation instructions.

instructions.heading: Grill and verify
instructions.action: Shake off excess marinade and grill, turning as needed to prevent scorching, until every thigh reaches 165°F / 74°C in its thickest part.
instructions.temperature: Medium heat with an open cooler zone
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Every piece reaches 165°F / 74°C with no reliance on color alone.
instructions.safetyNote: All poultry must reach 165°F / 74°C; check multiple pieces with a clean calibrated thermometer.

instructions.heading: Rest and serve
instructions.action: Transfer to a clean platter, apply only clean reserved sauce if used, and rest 3 minutes before serving.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: The meat has completed the stated rest on a clean platter.
instructions.safetyNote: Use clean utensils and do not return cooked meat to the raw-meat platter.

grillSetup: Use an outdoor grill or approved indoor electric grill with medium direct and cooler zones; prevent raw-chicken splashes and separate raw and cooked tools.
targetInternalTemperature: 165°F / 74°C in the thickest part of every chicken thigh.
visualDonenessCues: Juices are no longer visibly raw

allergens.crossContactWarning: Contains soy, wheat/gluten, and sesame; verify labels and prevent cross-contact.

substitutions: Use certified gluten-free tamari only after verifying every label.
ingredientSourcing: Choose cold chicken thighs in intact packaging and transport them home promptly.
makeAhead: Mix marinade up to 2 days ahead; marinate chicken only within the stated refrigerated range.
storage: Refrigerate cooked meat in a shallow covered container within 2 hours and use within 4 days pending food-safety approval.
reheating: Reheat only the needed portion to 165°F / 74°C until steaming; avoid repeated reheating.
leftovers: Use properly refrigerated leftovers in rice bowls or lettuce wraps within the approved window.
servingSuggestions: Serve with rice, lettuce wraps, and ssamjang.

faq.question: Can I rinse the chicken first?
faq.answer: No. Washing raw chicken can spread contamination by splashing.

faq.question: Can color prove doneness?
faq.answer: No. Verify 165°F / 74°C in every piece with a thermometer.
